written: 2026-09-28, after inspecting the data files (layout, protocol, cell-to-cell spread) and BEFORE any model run against them
question: Does the PyBaMM Chen2020 LG M50 cell model that flagship A uses (SPM) reproduce measured LG M50 constant-current discharges - terminal voltage, delivered capacity and surface-temperature rise - at the rate the flagship runs (C/2)?

data.source: Chen, Brosa Planella, O'Regan, Gastol, Widanage, Kendrick: Experimental data for 'Development of Experimental Techniques for Parameterization of Multi-scale Lithium-ion Battery Models'
data.protocol_as_recorded: per cell: CC-CV charge to 4.2 V at 1.5 A, 50 mA cut-off, 2 h rest, then CC discharge to 2.5 V at 0.5 / 2.5 / 5.0 / 7.5 A (C/10, C/2, 1C, 1.5C), each preceded by the same charge and rest; chamber about 26.7 degC; 30 s sampling; surface thermocouple

independence.known: the dataset authors describe these curves as the validation data of the paper that produced the Chen2020 parameters; same authors, same cell type, likely the same cell batch
independence.open: whether any Chen2020 parameter was tuned on these curves is not yet read from the paper text; until it is, a comparison is classified 'consistency with the authors' own validation data', not independent validation
independence.never: no Chen2020 electrochemical parameter is changed in this study

model.primary: PyBaMM SPM, parameter set Chen2020 as shipped with PyBaMM 26.8.0.0 (the model flagship A uses), lumped thermal
model.initial_state: SOC 1 at the discharge start (the protocol's CC-CV to 4.2 V with 50 mA cut-off and 2 h rest); initial temperature = measured surface temperature at the discharge start
model.ambient: mean measured chamber temperature over the discharge

only_calibrated_parameter.name: Total heat transfer coefficient [W.m-2.K-1]
only_calibrated_parameter.why: Chen2020 ships 10 W/m2K as a generic default, not a value for this test rig
only_calibrated_parameter.calibration_curve: cell02 at 1C, surface temperature only, one scalar, least squares on the measured samples
only_calibrated_parameter.held_out: every voltage curve (no voltage-side parameter is fitted), temperature at C/10, C/2 and 1.5C on all three cells, and temperature at 1C on cell03 and cell04

stated_limits: Chen2020 carries an Arrhenius dependence only on the exchange-current densities (35 and 17.8 kJ/mol); electrolyte transport and particle diffusion have none, so 1C and 1.5C (surface up to 58 degC) run outside the temperature range the set was built for
the lumped thermal model gives one cell temperature; the measurement is a surface thermocouple
instrument accuracy (Maccor voltage, thermocouple) is not stated in the dataset and stays UNKNOWN, not zero

metrics.evaluation_window: from the discharge start to the earlier of the measured and the modelled 2.5 V end, on the measured 30 s samples
metrics.voltage: RMSE and max |error| over the window
metrics.capacity: relative error of the delivered capacity to 2.5 V
metrics.temperature: error of the peak surface-temperature rise over the chamber, and RMSE over the window

acceptance_primary.scope: SPM, C/2 (the flagship's normal-case rate: 2.5 A on a 5 Ah cell), each of the three cells

V1.rationale: flagship A reports a degradation voltage shift of about 34 mV at this rate; a model whose error exceeds half of that cannot resolve it

T1.criterion: |peak-rise error| <= max(1.5 K, 25 % of the measured rise) on the held-out cells (all three are held out at C/2)

acceptance_primary.met_if: V1, C1 and T1 hold on all three cells

reported_not_judged: SPM, SPMe, DFN at C/10, C/2, 1C, 1.5C on all three cells: every metric above
each voltage RMSE divided by the cell-to-cell voltage spread at that rate
the calibrated heat-transfer coefficient and its fit residual
no_change_after_seeing_results: criteria, scope, calibration curve and held-out set are fixed; any other reading is labelled post hoc beside the pre-registered outcome
